integrity: Direct proof through semisimple quotient, elementary matrix decomposition, and lifting across Jacobson radical; exact finite checks accompany, but do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional unital algebras with field order greater than two. Binary universal identity fails; nonfinite-dimensional rings are not addressed. No independent mathematical review.
title: Exact augmentation-fibre unit-sumsets in finite-dimensional algebras
